trans.cn: thiếu cảnh giác, cả tin
trans.cn_source: 无警惕的，易受欺骗的

trans.cn: bất cẩn; bất cẩn; bất cẩn
trans.cn_source: 粗心的；不警惕的；不谨慎的

sentences.c: Tax can be a minefield for the unwary.
sentences.cn_source: 粗心大意的人在纳税方面很容易出错。

sentences.c: The stock market is full of traps for the unwary.
sentences.cn_source: 对无风险意识的人而言，股票市场充满了陷阱。

sentences.c: Specialist subjects are full of pitfalls for the unwary.
sentences.cn_source: 专业课程里充满了欺骗不警觉的人的陷阱。

trans.cn: tự truyện; viết tự truyện
trans.cn_source: 自传；自传体写作

sentences.c: He published his autobiography last autumn.
sentences.cn_source: 他去年秋天出版了他的自传。

sentences.c: His autobiography was written late in life.
sentences.cn_source: 他的自传是在晚年写的。

sentences.c: The novel is a thinly disguised autobiography.
sentences.cn_source: 这部小说让人一眼就可以看出是部自传。

trans.cn: Được xây dựng trên
trans.cn_source: 建立于

trans.cn: Phát triển hoặc mở rộng hơn nữa: xây dựng hoặc phát triển thêm trên cơ sở hiện có.
trans.cn_source: 进一步发展或扩展：在已有的基础上进行进一步的建设或发展。

sentences.c: They're going to build on the site of the old power station.
sentences.cn_source: 他们要在老发电站那里盖房子。

sentences.c: Kindness can build on itself as much as violence can.
sentences.cn_source: 善良可以像暴力一样建立在自身之上。

sentences.c: If you can't make a decision, build on other people's suggestions.
sentences.cn_source: 如果你不能自己做出决定，就参考别人的建议吧。

trans.cn: thịnh vượng, giàu có
trans.cn_source: 繁荣的，富足的

sentences.c: Dirty streets are no advertisement for a prosperous society.
sentences.cn_source: 肮脏的街道绝不是繁荣社会的景象。

sentences.c: Dirty streets and homelessness are no advertisement for a prosperous society.
sentences.cn_source: 肮脏的街道和无家可归现象绝不是繁荣社会的景象。

sentences.c: Barcelona has become one of the most dynamic and prosperous cities in the Mediterranean.
sentences.cn_source: 巴塞罗那已经成为地中海地区最具活力、最为繁荣的城市之一。

trans.cn: Thành thật mà nói (chèn)
trans.cn_source: 老实说（插入语）

trans.cn: Nói sự thật: Dùng để biểu thị rằng người nói đang thành thật thừa nhận điều gì đó.
trans.cn_source: 说实话：用于表示说话者正在诚实地承认某事。

trans.cn: Để nói cho bạn sự thật: Được sử dụng để biểu thị rằng người nói đang tiết lộ một sự thật một cách trung thực.
trans.cn_source: 实话告诉你：用于表示说话者正在诚实地透露某个事实。

sentences.c: To tell you the truth, I was afraid to see him.
sentences.cn_source: 跟你说实话，我怕见到他。

sentences.c: To tell you the truth, I'll be glad to get home.
sentences.cn_source: 说实话，能回家我会很高兴。

sentences.c: That day when you helped me, I felt very sad and now I decide to tell you the truth, you are such a nice friend!
sentences.cn_source: 那天当你帮助我的时候，我感到很难过，现在我决定告诉你真相，你这个朋友真是太好了！

trans.cn: Dụ dỗ, dụ dỗ; xúi giục, xúi giục; phải mạo hiểm...
trans.cn_source: 引诱，诱惑；怂恿，利诱；冒……的风险

sentences.c: Cars like that may tempt drivers to speed.
sentences.cn_source: 那样的汽车可能会引诱司机超速行驶。

sentences.c: Vivien refuses to put down bait to tempt wildlife to the waterhole.
sentences.cn_source: 维维恩拒绝放饵到水坑引诱野生动物。

sentences.c: Nothing could tempt her to evil.
sentences.cn_source: 什么也不能引诱她做坏事。

trans.cn: phụ lục; phụ lục
trans.cn_source: 阑尾；附录

sentences.c: Full details are given in Appendix 3.
sentences.cn_source: 详情见附录3。

sentences.c: We are not certain whether the appendix had already burst or not.
sentences.cn_source: 我们不能确定阑尾破了没有。

sentences.c: The book also includes an appendix with a listing of all U.S. presidents.
sentences.cn_source: 这本书还包含一个列有所有美国总统的附录。

sentences.c: He left today on a roundabout route for Jordan and is also due soon in Egypt.
sentences.cn_source: 他今天绕道前往约旦，也将很快到达埃及。

sentences.c: Freedom of speech is being realized in a roundabout way.
sentences.cn_source: 言论自由正在以一种迂回的方式实现。

sentences.c: It was a difficult and roundabout trip.
sentences.cn_source: 这是一次艰难而曲折的旅行。
